name: Gate Control Fragment
desc:
A mass of adamantine lattice and quantum circuitry cut from the command core of a destroyed Remnant Nexus. The Remnant network is descended from Domain military infrastructure, and its command nodes retain working knowledge of the Gate system that once bound the Domain together.

Delivered to a dormant Gate and integrated into its control systems by a competent engineering crew, this fragment can attune and restore that Gate to operation - once. The attunement process burns out the fragment entirely.
